info.title: Centreon Auto Discovery API
info.description:
# Authentication
There are two modes of authentication:
* By token: after identification with your login credentials
* By cookie: by reusing a valid session ID

status.description:
Job status:
 * `0` - STATUS_SCHEDULED
 * `1` - STATUS_FINISH
 * `2` - STATUS_FAILED
 * `3` - STATUS_RUNNING
 * `4` - STATUS_SAVE_RUNNING
 * `5` - STATUS_SAVE_FINISH
 * `6` - STATUS_SAVE_WARNING

save_mode.description:
save_mode:
  * `1` - ADD_HOST
  * `2` - DISABLE_HOST
  * `4` - ENABLE_HOST
  * `8` - ENABLE_EXPORT_RELOAD
  * `16`- UPDATE_HOST
  * `32`- DO_NOT_APPLY_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE

This property is only mandatory when the analysis_mode is equal to 1 (AUTOMATIC_ANALYSIS).

To select more than one option, you have to add up their values.

Example: *If I select the options ADD_HOST and ENABLE_HOST => save_mode=5 (1+4)*

DiscoveredHost.save.description:
**Only hosts discovered without a mapping error will be saved.**
* When all = true, we will save all discovered hosts except those given by ids.
* When all = false, we will save the discovered hosts based on the given ids.

ids.description: List of discovered host ids to be saved

DiscoveryJob.scheduling.description:
Allows you to define the scheduling of the task.

Either the cron expression is directly defined or you just have to complete the properties
minutes, hours, days, months and weekdays.

weekdays.description:
**Represent the days of the week.**
* `0` - Sunday
* `1` - Monday
* `2` - Tuesday
* `3` - Wednesday
* `4` - Thursday
* `5` - Friday
* `6` - Saturday
* `7` - Sunday

**Exemples of allowed values:**
* To represent a single value: 5
* To represent several values: 1,5,9,51
* To represent a range of values: 4-15
* To represent all possible values: \*
